# gyro_server_security_groups (Resource)

The exact list of security groups attached to a server (Network Firewall add-on), in evaluation order (max 5). With groups attached and no gyro_firewall rules, inbound traffic that no group allows is denied. Destroy detaches all groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach both groups to a server (order = evaluation order, max 5). Without gyro_firewall rules, inbound traffic
# that no group allows is denied.
resource "gyro_server_security_groups" "web1" {
  server_id          = 1234
  security_group_ids = [gyro_security_group.web.id, gyro_security_group.admin.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `security_group_ids` (List of String) Group ids (sg-xxxxxxxx), max 5.
- `server_id` (Number) Server id.

### Optional

- `confirm_trial` (Boolean) A change that could cut SSH/RDP access runs as a 5 minute trial; true (default) confirms it right after apply.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_server_security_groups.web1 1234
```
